status: prepared; paused until explicit user confirmation that external build is finished

policy.attempt_identity: monotonically increasing global attempt; distinct from logical block
policy.order: rotation and reversal depend only on logical block; replay uses the same order
policy.rejection: discard entire attempt of logical block only on process-name guard match
policy.known_pid_privacy: inspect known Cargo/rustc PID arguments privately only to classify family; persist PID, family, comm and parent names; no full args or environment

retention.PLAN.json: written before initial quiet wait; runner/guard/archive hashes plus deterministic per-block orders
retention.attempts.jsonl: all completed process records from every attempt
retention.ledger.jsonl: accepted/rejected attempt IDs, start/end UTC, record offsets/counts, and guard evidence; empty rejected attempts preserved
retention.rejected-blocks.jsonl: guard evidence for every rejected whole-block attempt
